description: Illustrative Bayesian model, not the production model.

baseline_pace.title: Baseline pace
baseline_pace.text: An uncertain underlying pace in seconds per kilometre. The prior is centred at 4:12/km. The trials update this distribution.

fictional_trials.title: Pace observations
fictional_trials.text: Six pace measurements: 253, 245, 260, 249, 247 and 254 s/km. Their observation noise is fixed at 15 s/km for this model.

race_day_effect.title: Race-day variation
race_day_effect.text: A zero-centred offset with standard deviation 12 s/km. It represents a hypothetical better or worse race day. It is not learned from these trials.

predicted_pace.title: Predicted race pace
predicted_pace.text: Baseline pace plus the race-day offset. Each posterior draw produces another plausible pace, preserving uncertainty rather than using a single best estimate.

finish_time.title: 10 km finish time
finish_time.text: Multiply predicted pace (s/km) by the fixed distance of 10 km. This is a unit conversion; there is no distance-scaling or training-transfer model here.
